headline.text: L2 finished goods on quarantine after *5 barrels* of quarantine-status caramel loaded and run — 13 LPNs of caramel on hold at L3 for FM.

summary: Three active holds: L2 finished goods quarantined after quarantine-status caramel used in production, L3 caramel lot on hold for foreign material, L1 Mac nut pallet on hold for undersize. L1 S2 caramel viscosity ran 5k–19k cPs vs 19k minimum through full run — approved to continue but root cause unknown.

holds.title: Finished goods quarantined after quarantine caramel used
holds.summary: 5 barrels of caramel (21117) in quarantine status were loaded and run — 3 on 2nd shift, 2 on 3rd shift — before catch; 180 of 191 barrels total are quarantine status, finished product placed on quarantine pending disposition.
holds.status: Finished goods on quarantine; 8 OK-status barrels available to continue production.

holds.title: Caramel lot on hold for foreign material
holds.summary: FM found in caramel item 10256 lot 61H16X161H this morning — 13 LPNs placed on systematic hold (11 initially, 2 added after inventory adjustment).
holds.status: On hold — 13 LPNs labeled and isolated by warehouse.

holds.title: Mac nut pallet on hold — undersize for Costco spec
holds.summary: One pallet of Mac nuts labeled for Costco found with very small pieces during 2nd shift S3 — removed from line and placed on hold pending QA disposition.
holds.status: On hold — pallet isolated, QA notified.

food_safety.title: Foreign material in caramel ingredient lot
food_safety.summary: FM discovered in caramel item 10256 lot 61H16X161H — 13 LPNs of ingredient placed on hold; lot used at ML4.
food_safety.status: 13 LPNs on hold and labeled; team instructed to stop using lot.

food_safety.title: Damaged belt piece found at Theegarten 5 startup
food_safety.summary: Small piece of belt received by operator at start of 3rd shift ML4 Theegarten 5 — maintenance replaced blue belt to prevent foreign material risk, ATP verified before installation.
food_safety.status: Resolved — belt replaced, ATP passed, line running.

quality.title: S2 chocolate tempering issues — melting tank overtemp
quality.summary: Mini temper unit producing high temper (1.1+) — investigation found decorator melting tank set at 60°C (should be 52°C), causing buffer tank to heat over time and degrade temper performance.
quality.status: Resolved — melting tank corrected to 52°C, buffer stable at 87–90°F, temper holding below 1.0 through 3rd shift.

quality.title: S2 caramel viscosity significantly low all shifts
quality.summary: Caramel viscosity measured 5k cPs at startup vs 19k minimum spec — first batch scrapped, second batch also low (11k–20k range); R&D approved to run as-is but noted inconsistency and questioned testing standard.
quality.status: Running with QA approval — viscosity holding 11k–20k cPs range, below historical but deposit appearance acceptable; root cause not identified.

quality.title: WIP from previous lot found on floor at FFS
quality.summary: Piece of WIP from previous lot found on ground next to FFS during 3rd shift walk — line clearance not complete before batch change.
quality.status: Isolated — reminder issued to all shifts to conduct full line sweep and inspect all areas for leftover WIP.

opportunities.text: Review S2 caramel cook process and Sucrotherm settings — today's viscosity ran 5k–20k cPs vs 19k minimum across three cooks with no process changes identified.
Consider adding ingredient status verification step to ML2 caramel loading checklist — based on today's 5 barrels of quarantine-status caramel loaded before catch.
Reinforce FFS line clearance procedure and add floor-area inspection requirement — today's WIP piece from previous lot found on ground at shift start.
Consider adding flow-wrap belt integrity inspection to ML4 Theegarten startup checklist — today's damaged belt piece at shift start echoes earlier packaging belt issues.
